full_page.content:
1943, April 29
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten message on a Seraphic Mass Association card by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Missing Brother of Sister Mary Dolores, O. P. of St. Andrews Convent. Flushing, L. Isl. N. Y. -- speedy return home. D. V.
emergency special membership. We'll pray for him too and will trust in God and our Bl. Mother Mary.
"Whom the Lord loveth, He chasteneth!" April 29, 1948
P. S. Tell your Br's. wife to ask Mrs. Euphasia Cunningham (a Ist cousin of mine) for her prayers. She is almost an invalid but likes to help. Lives at 323 e. Boone, Spokane, Wash'n.
Original in possession of : Sister M. Dolores, O. P. Northwest Catholic Convent Wampanoag Drive & North Main St. West Hartford, CO. 06177
